15//! Immutable native-reader metadata shares the decoded SST reservation.
16
17use std::any::{Any, TypeId};
18use std::sync::Arc;
19
20use store_api::storage::FileId;
21
22use crate::cache::{CacheStrategy, ColumnarMetaCache};
23use crate::error::Result;
24use crate::metrics::{CACHE_BYTES, CACHE_HIT, CACHE_LOAD, CACHE_MISS};
25
26const COLUMNAR_META: &str = "columnar_metadata";
27
28/// Identity of one immutable native-reader structure.
29#[derive(Debug, Clone, Hash, PartialEq, Eq)]
30pub(crate) struct DecodedKey {
31    namespace: FileId,
32    identity: String,
33    representation: TypeId,
34}
35
36#[derive(Clone)]
37pub(crate) struct DecodedValue {
38    value: Arc<dyn Any + Send + Sync>,
39    weight: u32,
40}
41impl DecodedValue {
42    pub(crate) fn label(&self) -> &'static str {
43        COLUMNAR_META
44    }
45}
46/// Weigher for the native-reader metadata tier; the value carries its own admitted weight.
47pub(crate) fn columnar_meta_weight(_key: &DecodedKey, value: &DecodedValue) -> u32 {
48    value.weight
49}
50
51/// Contains no artifact handle or live object-store reader. Loads run independently;
52/// admission uses a synchronous, atomic cache entry after loading.
53#[derive(Clone)]
54pub(crate) struct MetadataCache {
55    cache: ColumnarMetaCache,
56    namespace: FileId,
57}
58impl CacheStrategy {
59    pub(crate) fn columnar_metadata(&self, namespace: FileId) -> Option<MetadataCache> {
60        let Self::EnableAll(manager) = self else {
61            return None;
62        };
63        Some(MetadataCache {
64            cache: manager.columnar_meta_cache.clone()?,
65            namespace,
66        })
67    }
68}

70// Native payload blocks used to share the page-cache budget through the shared
71// `PageRangeCache`, which main replaced with `ParquetPageCache`. That cache serves
72// uniform-size blocks fetched through a reader, so it cannot hold these aligned blocks
73// clipped to the payload area.
74// TODO(narthex-merge): re-attach native payload byte caching to a dedicated page-cache
75// budget in `CacheManager`; until then payload reads stay uncached.
76/// Placeholder for the disabled native payload byte cache.
77#[allow(dead_code)]
78#[derive(Clone)]
79pub(crate) struct PayloadCache {
80    namespace: FileId,
81}
82
83impl CacheStrategy {
84    pub(crate) fn columnar_payload(&self, _namespace: FileId) -> Option<PayloadCache> {
85        None
86    }
87}
88
89/// Placeholder for one cached payload block; lookups always miss.
90#[allow(dead_code)]
91pub(crate) struct PayloadPartCache {
92    namespace: FileId,
93    generation: FileId,
94    part: u32,
95    file_size: u64,
96}
97
98impl PayloadCache {
99    pub(crate) fn part(&self, generation: FileId, part: u32, file_size: u64) -> PayloadPartCache {
100        PayloadPartCache {
101            namespace: self.namespace,
102            generation,
103            part,
104            file_size,
105        }
106    }
107}
108
109impl PayloadPartCache {
110    pub(crate) fn get(&self, _range: &std::ops::Range<u64>) -> Option<bytes::Bytes> {
111        CACHE_MISS.with_label_values(&["columnar_payload"]).inc();
112        None
113    }
114
115    pub(crate) fn insert(&self, _range: &std::ops::Range<u64>, _bytes: &bytes::Bytes) {}
116}

118/// Loads only validated immutable structures. Identities include the generation path,
119/// object length, and the complete reference/codec context used to validate the value.
120/// Oversized entries bypass admission; disabled caches perform the same validation.
121pub(crate) async fn load<T: Send + Sync + 'static>(
122    cache: Option<&MetadataCache>,
123    identity: String,
124    weight: impl FnOnce(&T) -> usize,
125    loader: impl Future<Output = Result<T>>,
126) -> Result<Arc<T>> {
127    let Some(context) = cache else {
128        return loader.await.map(Arc::new);
129    };
130    let key = DecodedKey {
131        namespace: context.namespace,
132        identity,
133        representation: TypeId::of::<T>(),
134    };
135    let get = || {
136        context
137            .cache
138            .get(&key)
139            .and_then(|value| value.value.downcast::<T>().ok())
140    };
141    if let Some(value) = get() {
142        CACHE_HIT.with_label_values(&[COLUMNAR_META]).inc();
143        return Ok(value);
144    }
145    CACHE_MISS.with_label_values(&[COLUMNAR_META]).inc();
146    CACHE_LOAD.with_label_values(&[COLUMNAR_META]).inc();
147    let value = Arc::new(loader.await?);
148    // A caller may flush buffered output while its loader is Pending, then stop
149    // polling it under downstream backpressure. Never hold a shared lock across
150    // that await: another stream may need the lock to finish the current series.
151    let identity_size = key.identity.capacity();
152    let retained = weight(&value).saturating_add(identity_size).saturating_add(
153        std::mem::size_of::<DecodedKey>()
154            + std::mem::size_of::<DecodedValue>()
155            + 2 * std::mem::size_of::<usize>(),
156    );
157    if let Ok(weight) = u32::try_from(retained)
158        && u64::from(weight) <= context.cache.policy().max_capacity().unwrap_or(0)
159    {
160        let entry = context.cache.entry(key).or_insert_with(|| DecodedValue {
161            value: value.clone(),
162            weight,
163        });
164        if entry.is_fresh() {
165            CACHE_BYTES
166                .with_label_values(&[COLUMNAR_META])
167                .add(i64::from(weight));
168        }
169        let admitted = entry.into_value().value;
170        if let Ok(admitted) = admitted.downcast::<T>() {
171            return Ok(admitted);
172        }
173    }
174    Ok(value)
175}

177#[cfg(test)]
178mod tests {
179    use super::*;
180    use crate::cache::CacheManager;
181    use std::hash::{DefaultHasher, Hash, Hasher};
182
183    // TODO(narthex-merge): restore payload-block assertions once the byte cache gets a budget.
184    #[test]
185    fn payload_cache_stays_disabled_without_a_page_budget() {
186        let manager = Arc::new(CacheManager::builder().page_cache_size(4096).build());
187        let strategy = CacheStrategy::EnableAll(manager);
188        assert!(strategy.columnar_payload(FileId::random()).is_none());
189        assert!(
190            CacheStrategy::EnableAll(Arc::new(CacheManager::default()))
191                .columnar_payload(FileId::random())
192                .is_none()
193        );
194        assert!(
195            CacheStrategy::Disabled
196                .columnar_payload(FileId::random())
197                .is_none()
198        );
199    }
200
201    #[rstest::rstest]
202    #[case::same_key(false)]
203    #[case::stripe_collision(true)]
204    #[tokio::test]
205    async fn backpressured_load_does_not_block_other_readers(#[case] different_key: bool) {
206        let manager = CacheManager::builder()
207            .sst_meta_cache_size(8192)
208            .enable_columnar_meta_cache(true)
209            .build();
210        let strategy = CacheStrategy::EnableAll(Arc::new(manager));
211        let cache = strategy.columnar_metadata(FileId::random()).unwrap();
212        let identity = "generation/part/page";
213        // Keep the former stripe collision as a regression case for the old loader.
214        let stripe = |identity: &str| {
215            let key = DecodedKey {
216                namespace: cache.namespace,
217                identity: identity.to_string(),
218                representation: TypeId::of::<Vec<u8>>(),
219            };
220            let mut hash = DefaultHasher::new();
221            key.hash(&mut hash);
222            hash.finish() as usize % 32
223        };
224        let other_identity = if different_key {
225            (0..)
226                .map(|i| format!("other/{i}"))
227                .find(|other| stripe(other) == stripe(identity))
228                .unwrap()
229        } else {
230            identity.to_string()
231        };
232        let (complete, pending) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel();
233        let mut owner = Box::pin(load(
234            Some(&cache),
235            "generation/part/page".into(),
236            |_| 64,
237            async {
238                pending.await.unwrap();
239                Ok(vec![1u8, 2, 3])
240            },
241        ));
242        assert!(futures::poll!(&mut owner).is_pending());
243        // Deliver the I/O wake, but deliberately never poll its owner again until
244        // the second reader completes. This models a stream paused after a flush.
245        complete.send(()).unwrap();
246        let other = tokio::time::timeout(
247            std::time::Duration::from_secs(1),
248            load(Some(&cache), other_identity, |_| 64, async {
249                Ok(vec![1u8, 2, 3])
250            }),
251        )
252        .await
253        .unwrap()
254        .unwrap();
255        assert_eq!(other.as_slice(), &[1, 2, 3]);
256        let first = owner.await.unwrap();
257        if !different_key {
258            assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&first, &other));
259        }
260        let cached = load(Some(&cache), "generation/part/page".into(), |_| 64, async {
261            panic!("must reuse the admitted entry")
262        })
263        .await
264        .unwrap();
265        assert!(Arc::ptr_eq(&first, &cached));
266
267        let mut canceled = Box::pin(load(
268            Some(&cache),
269            "canceled".into(),
270            |_| 64,
271            std::future::pending::<Result<Vec<u8>>>(),
272        ));
273        assert!(futures::poll!(&mut canceled).is_pending());
274        drop(canceled);
275        let retry = load(Some(&cache), "canceled".into(), |_| 64, async {
276            Ok(vec![4u8])
277        })
278        .await
279        .unwrap();
280        assert_eq!(&[4], retry.as_slice());
281    }
282    #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 4)]
283    async fn concurrent_misses_share_the_admitted_value() {
284        let strategy = CacheStrategy::EnableAll(Arc::new(
285            CacheManager::builder()
286                .sst_meta_cache_size(8192)
287                .enable_columnar_meta_cache(true)
288                .build(),
289        ));
290        let cache = strategy.columnar_metadata(FileId::random()).unwrap();
291        let barrier = Arc::new(tokio::sync::Barrier::new(64));
292        let tasks = (0..64)
293            .map(|_| {
294                let cache = cache.clone();
295                let barrier = barrier.clone();
296                tokio::spawn(async move {
297                    load(Some(&cache), "shared-generation".into(), |_| 64, async {
298                        barrier.wait().await;
299                        Ok(vec![1_u8; 64])
300                    })
301                    .await
302                    .unwrap()
303                })
304            })
305            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
306        let values = tokio::time::timeout(
307            std::time::Duration::from_secs(5),
308            futures::future::try_join_all(tasks),
309        )
310        .await
311        .unwrap()
312        .unwrap();
313        assert!(values.iter().all(|value| Arc::ptr_eq(value, &values[0])));
314    }
